text: Shimizu et al. separately describe SCAT's general four-step coding process and the six steps used in this study: entering text in the SCAT form; grouping individual data strips by similarity; rewording each group; conceptualizing potential themes from relationships between groups; writing a storyline incorporating all data; and writing a theory from the conceptualization. Treat this as the study's reported implementation, not a replacement for the general SCAT description.
